abs-landing-page.note: a preprint server's abstract landing page stored as a paper body: landing-page labels, no body section; fails abstract_only

press-article.note: a complete article laid out as an Article-in-Press PDF (banner on the first page), references at the end; ok, and in_press

press-references.note: the reference section of the same kind of PDF alone; fails references_only, and in_press

press-running-headers.note: a body whose journal name, DOI and Article-in-Press line repeat on every page; flags repeated_lines, and in_press

indonesian-paper.note: a paper written in Indonesian; flags non_english

japanese-abstract.note: an in-band abstract mostly in Japanese with English terms; flags non_latin, not non_english

latex-residue-page.note: a web page whose rendered formulas came through as raw LaTeX source; flags latex_residue

toc-dot-leaders.note: a PDF table of contents with dot leaders: the glyph-run pattern matches, the glyph_runs metric stays 0

figure-text.note: PDF text around a figure whose axis ticks and legend came out as a picture-text block; flags figure_text

short-blog-post.note: a short but complete blog post from a heavy HTML page, text-to-raw ratio just above the flag; ok

abstract-only-page.note: a research page that is only an abstract and a link, from a heavy HTML page; flags low_text_ratio, not too_short

replacement-chars-pdf.note: PDF text whose figure block came out as U+FFFD replacement characters; fails replacement (quality_garbled)
